title: Bitcoin tests key support as Binance security fears weigh
summary: Bitcoin is trading to new session lows, bringing its 100-day moving average at $76,139 into focus. The low so far has reached $76,172, leaving the price just $33 above a key technical level that could help define the next move. Sentiment has been unsettled by reports of an alleged Binance security breach. The account circulating describes $6.3B of assets being drained from wallets across multiple blockchains over a 20 minute period on Thursday, raising concerns about customer funds, exchange security and potential spillover across the cryptocurrency ecosystem. North Korea is being targeted for the breach. Security scares can put additional pressure on prices when leveraged positions are involved. Falling prices trigger margin calls and forced liquidations, which can generate further selling. That process can magnify the initial reaction as traders reduce exposure and wait for clarity. The broader backdrop also remains challenging, with inflation risks, growth concerns and geopolitical tensions weighing on risk appetite. The 100-day MA becomes the immediate barometer Technically, for Bitcoin traders, the immediate question is whether buyers can defend the 100-day moving average at $76,139.
